name: haichi-engine
description: A tiny pure engine for making large structures viewable and memorable — cluster, place (2D/3D/town), shape terrain, plant greenery, and measure whether it is readable and mappable. Decides WHERE things go, never draws them. Dependency-free, deterministic, headless-testable.
